title: Proof of a conjecture of Andrews and Bachraoui on a Hecke sum
summary: In this paper, we prove a conjecture of Andrews and Bachraoui relating a generating function arising from two-color partitions (with odd smallest part and restrictions on the even parts) to a Hecke-type double sum. Our proof is based on Zwegers' theory of indefinite theta functions together with modular transformation properties of mock theta functions.
